summary: Add staged Maxit own-number top-up adapter to the existing private Companion payment runtime.
reason: Maxit must use its own provider order contract while reusing the canonical Payment Core and ClicToPay issuer rail.
rollback: Revert the scoped runtime commit and keep the Maxit live-acceptance gate absent. Never replay an engaged or indeterminate PaymentRecord.

tests.name: typescript-build
tests.evidence: Companion TypeScript build passed using deterministic worktree dependency hydration.

tests.name: maxit-adapter
tests.evidence: 3/3 tests prove default gate closure, Maxit-specific start payload with no Topnet invoice fields, and read-only same-transaction resume/timeout reconciliation.

tests.name: payment-core
tests.evidence: 58/58 tests passed; Topnet timeout behavior remains unchanged while providers may supply explicit timeoutReconcile.

tests.name: clictopay-provider
tests.evidence: 2/2 generic ClicToPay provider adapter tests passed.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth and MCP routing are owned by ui-playbooks payment.owner_native.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing provider adapter interface and Payment Core; no new runtime owner, registry, store, daemon, scheduler or retry engine.

limitations: The Maxit live-acceptance gate is absent.
No real Maxit order, bank submission or recharge is part of this runtime delivery.
Real financial certification remains the next explicit owner test.
